purpose.en: Close one milestone without starting another.
purpose.zh: 闭环一个里程碑，然后停止。

entry.en: Implementation, review and non-live checks are complete
entry.zh: 实现、审阅与非真实验证完成

steps.zh: 列明仅真实环境待证项

exit.en: Reviewed buildable source and concise completion evidence are handed over.
exit.zh: 交付审阅过的可构建源码和简洁完成证据。

failure.en: Incomplete code returns to implementation; missing live evidence stays separate.
failure.zh: 代码缺口返回开发；真实环境待证项单独列出。

boundary.en: Do not initiate real conversations, Computer Use or per-worker installations.
boundary.zh: 不自行启动真实对话、Computer Use 或各自安装客户端。
